routeNote: That the Western Yamuna Canal runs from the Tajewala headworks down to Munak is documented. This drawn line is a smooth approximation of that corridor — it is not the surveyed canal alignment.
The Munak-to-Haiderpur delivery is documented; the alignment drawn here is approximate. The real channel does not run in straight segments.

Wholly invented geometry. No agency publishes trunk main routes. What is documented is that mains of this class exist — DJB reports ≈750 km of trunk mains between 900 and 1,900 mm diameter — and that a main known as the 'Naraina main' is real enough that the neighbouring ACE (M)-8 zone still feeds Subhash Nagar UGR by direct tapping off it. The line drawn here is a plausible corridor, nothing more.
Invented geometry. Drawn along the road corridor between the reservoir's approximate position and the centre of Naraina Vihar.
